paper.title_en: Isospin violating decay of D wave charmonia
paper.abstract_en: The experimental observations of $ψ(3823)$ and $ψ(3842)$ enrich the $D$ wave charmonia family. In our previous work the decays of $ψ(3823)$ and $ψ(3842)$ to isospin conserved non-$D\bar D$ hadronic decays are well studied. Since the isospin violated decay channel $ψ(3770)\to J/ψπ$ is measured clearly very recently, so in this work we fit the model parameter $α$ through $BR(ψ(3770)\to J/ψπ)_{exp}$, then study the contribution of isospin violated decay channels of $ψ(3770)\to h_cπ$, $ψ(3823)$ and $ψ(3842)$ to $J/ψπ$ and $h_cπ$, respectively. With this range of parameters space, the branching ratio of $ψ(3770)\to h_cπ$ is estimated to be $(2.7\sim4.4)\times10^{-7}$. The decay widths of $ψ(3823)$ and $ψ(3842)$ to $J/ψπ$ and $h_cπ$ are also estimated. Our results show that the partial width of $ψ(3823)\to J/ψπ$ is $1.12\sim1.77$ eV, the value for $ψ(3823)\to h_cπ$ is $0.71\sim1.04$ eV, and $0.028\sim0.044$ eV for $ψ(3842)\to J/ψπ$, $0.34\sim0.49$ eV for $ψ(3842)\to h_cπ$, respectively. We hope those values could be tested by further precise measurements from the BES III, Belle II and LHCb Collaborations.
